scripts.build: pnpm exec hardhat build && pnpm export-artifacts
scripts.test:fork: MAINNET_FORK=1 pnpm exec hardhat test mocha
scripts.test:predeploy: FORK_BLOCK=25271161 REQUIRE_FORK_TESTS=1 MAINNET_FORK=1 pnpm exec hardhat test mocha
scripts.test:fork:aa: MAINNET_FORK=1 pnpm exec hardhat test mocha 'test/Integration/*.test.ts' 'test/UsdtPaymaster/*.test.ts' 'test/A7A5AccountFactory/*.test.ts' 'test/A7A5EIP7702Account/*.test.ts' test/A7A5WebAuthnAccount/account-fork.test.ts
scripts.fork:deploy: pnpm exec hardhat run scripts/fork-setup-and-demo.ts --network localhost --show-stack-traces
scripts.fund:smart-account: pnpm exec hardhat run scripts/fund-smart-account.ts --network localhost
scripts.deploy:mainnet: pnpm predeploy:prepare mainnet && pnpm exec hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/A7A5AA.ts --network mainnet --parameters .ignition-parameters/mainnet.json --verify
scripts.deploy:sepolia: pnpm predeploy:prepare sepolia && pnpm exec hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/A7A5AA_Sepolia.ts --network sepolia --parameters .ignition-parameters/sepolia.json --verify
scripts.deploy:sepolia:dry-run: pnpm exec hardhat ignition visualize ignition/modules/A7A5AA_Sepolia.ts
scripts.lint:slither:high: rm -f slither-report.sarif && slither . --config-file slither.config.json --exclude medium --exclude low --exclude informational
scripts.audit: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:sol && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm lint:slither
scripts.storage-layout: pnpm exec hardhat compile && pnpm exec hardhat storage-layout
scripts.test:gas: REPORT_GAS=true pnpm exec hardhat test mocha --require ./test/gas-reporter-setup.ts
